name: lizard yoga pose utthan pristhasana
description: A deep lunge-based lizard pose that opens the hips and inner thighs, with the hands or forearms supported on the floor.
instructions: Step one foot forward outside the same-side hand into a low lunge.
Extend the rear leg back and support yourself on your hands; lower to your forearms only if comfortable.
Let your hips sink gently while keeping the front foot planted.
Breathe steadily, then step back and switch sides.
